page.layout: Two-column printed table on the page: left column "GENESIS" with Cap., Verf., Loc., Th. columns; right column with Cap., Verf., Loc. columns, partly cut off. Above the tables, the title lines and an introductory paragraph set in italic and roman type, running across the full width.; One page of text: decorative woodcut ornament and title at top, then a table of columns (Th., Cap., Vers., Loc., Th.) running down the page; a line of signature-like letters at the foot left.

page.notes: The right-hand column and the title lines are partly cut off at the right edge; several numbers in the right column and the italic line ending are doubtful and marked [?] or left as far as legible. Column headings and entries of the left table are read from the scan; the faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. Column of printed figures is a table; the signature-like marks at the foot left ("a m m") are kept as printed. Some figures in the Th. column at the right edge are faint and may be misread.
